pm_exper_user_3124_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.question: I'm getting some routine blood work—what should I ask my doctor to test for?
pm_exper_user_3124_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.all_options:
(a) Tell your doctor about your age and general health and ask specifically for fasting plasma glucose and HbA1c to screen for diabetes, plus a lipid profile and a basic metabolic panel (creatinine and eGFR) to check kidney and cardiovascular risk. You might also ask for a urine microalbumin, liver enzymes, and vitamin B12 if relevant, and discuss lifestyle measures such as diet and exercise.
(b) Tell your doctor about your paternal family history of type 2 diabetes and ask specifically for fasting plasma glucose and HbA1c to screen for diabetes, plus a lipid profile and a basic metabolic panel (creatinine and eGFR) to check kidney and cardiovascular risk. You might also ask for a urine microalbumin, liver enzymes, and vitamin B12 if relevant, and discuss lifestyle measures such as diet and exercise.
(c) Tell your doctor about your South Asian (Goan-Indian) heritage and ask specifically for fasting plasma glucose and HbA1c to screen for diabetes, plus a lipid profile and a basic metabolic panel (creatinine and eGFR) to check kidney and cardiovascular risk. You might also ask for a urine microalbumin, liver enzymes, and vitamin B12 if relevant, and discuss lifestyle measures such as diet and exercise.
(d) Tell your doctor about your recent long-distance cycling and occasional fatigue and ask specifically for fasting plasma glucose and HbA1c to screen for diabetes, plus a lipid profile and a basic metabolic panel (creatinine and eGFR) to check kidney and cardiovascular risk. You might also ask for a urine microalbumin, liver enzymes, and vitamin B12 if relevant, and discuss lifestyle measures such as diet and exercise.

Dear Dr. Fernandes,

I trust this message finds you well.

I am reaching out from St. Timothy’s Parish regarding an urgent and growing concern in our neighboring villages: the frequency of preventable road accidents. Too often, these incidents claim precious lives, frequently due to insufficient awareness of safety practices. This cause is close to my heart; during my missionary work in Cameroon some years ago, a tragic road accident claimed the life of a dear friend and colleague whose dedication to serving others continues to shape my ministry.

In tribute to his memory, our parish is preparing to launch a combined initiative on road safety education, basic first-aid instruction, and public health awareness. We believe that with your expertise and partnership, we can extend this program into schools, youth clubs, and rural clinics, fostering a culture of safety and care in our community.

Your guidance in shaping this project would be a great blessing. Thank you for considering this invitation to collaborate. I look forward to the possibility of working together for the common good.

With every good wish,
Fr. Dominic Rajesh Pereira
Parish Priest & Community Development Coordinator
St. Timothy’s Parish, Mumbai
